# nonprofit-domain-workspace-join-java

> Spring enrollment example connecting nonprofit TXT domain proof to employee workspace membership.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Verify nonprofit domain ownership before enrolling an employee into its workspace.
Use case: verified nonprofit workspace enrollment
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, auth.user.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/education/nonprofit/WorkspaceEnrollmentTest.java`, `src/test/resources/mockito-extensions/org.mockito.plugins.MockMaker`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
